verdict.rationale: Wise documents 'global account details' for getting paid and receiving in 40+ currencies, and community reports confirm Business accounts carry USD account details. That supports viewing account and routing numbers. Nothing in the evidence mentions generating a bank verification letter. Community reports of USD details being changed with zero-day notice also add a reliability caveat. Missing for 10: any evidence of bank verification letter generation, explicit documentation of where routing/account numbers are shown in the Business dashboard, and on-demand access to them.
